# tvN & TVING by CJ ENM

> > Official showcase of tvN and TVING's premium Korean entertainment content, featuring dramas, films, and variety shows from CJ ENM's global content ecosystem.

tvN.tving.com serves as the international content hub for CJ ENM's entertainment brands, highlighting original productions from tvN, TVING, and Mnet. The site showcases CJ ENM's position as a leading K-content producer and distributor, featuring award-winning Korean dramas, films, and variety programming for global audiences.
